title: Book 2 — Euterpe, Chapter 338
paragraphs: As for the stories told by the Egyptians, anyone to whom such things seem credible may accept them. For my part, it should be understood throughout the whole of this history that I write by hearsay what each people report in their own place. The Egyptians say that Demeter and Dionysos are rulers of the world below. The Egyptians are also the first to have reported the doctrine that the human soul is immortal, and that when the body dies, the soul enters another creature that happens at that moment to be coming to birth; and when it has gone round all the creatures of land and sea and air, it enters again into a human body as that body comes to birth, and it completes this round in a period of three thousand years. This doctrine certain Greeks adopted, some earlier and some later, as if it were their own invention, and I know the names of these men but refrain from recording them.
